operations.value: Add a combined synchronization command that performs the POC-safe origin sequence: fetch Workbook task refs into isolated tracking refs, validate and fast-forward/create compatible local refs, stop before pushing when fetched histories diverge or fail validation, then push every local task ref. Keep operations explicit, report per-task fetch and push outcomes, never touch code branches or create a hidden tasks branch, and leave multi-remote support and domain reconciliation for later work.
